title: Riesz Representation for Lp Spaces
description: Can the Riesz representation theorem (Lp)* ≅ Lq be derived from the eLpNorm Hölder inequality? Answer: partially — the embedding direction yes, surjectivity requires Radon-Nikodým.

meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: riesz_lp_surjective (the hard direction requiring Radon-Nikodym). L2 case fully proved via InnerProductSpace.toDual. Embedding direction proved via Hölder.

overview.problemStatement: Can the Riesz representation theorem (Lp)* ≅ Lq be derived from the eLpNorm Hölder inequality?
overview.text: The Riesz representation theorem identifies the dual of Lp with Lq for conjugate exponents. Hölder's inequality provides the embedding direction; the surjectivity requires Radon-Nikodým.
overview.proofStrategy: L2 self-duality via Fréchet-Riesz (Mathlib), Hölder for Lq → (Lp)* embedding, Radon-Nikodým for surjectivity (axiomatized).
keyInsights: Hölder's inequality gives the isometric embedding Lq ↪ (Lp)* but NOT surjectivity
The L2 case is special: Hilbert space structure gives both directions
Surjectivity for general Lp requires constructing the representing function via Radon-Nikodým
